decisions.what: Removed all workflow handle/query construction from adv_gate_status
decisions.why: AC1 requires gate status to be a durable-projection read; querying a live workflow defeats worker-free operation and is unnecessary because change.gates, directive derivation, and next-action can all be computed from the persisted projection.

decisions.what: Removed getGateCriteriaQuery and getAcceptanceCriteriaProjectionQuery imports from gate.ts
decisions.why: These queries were only consumed by adv_gate_status; removing them resolves lint errors after the handler became projection-only.

decisions.what: Removed isPoisonedHistoryError and isWorkflowCompletedError imports from gate.ts
decisions.why: The poisoned-history fallback path in adv_gate_status was part of the workflow-query branch and is no longer reachable.

decisions.what: Added typed _unavailable markers for gateCriteria and acceptanceCriteriaProjection
decisions.why: AC2 requires truthful incompleteness; these fields are workflow-only and not persisted in the durable change snapshot, so absence must be reported explicitly rather than treated as a pass or silently omitted.

decisions.what: Updated existing gate.test.ts and gate.acceptance-criteria-projection.test.ts to match worker-free semantics
decisions.why: Preserving test greenness while reflecting the new contract; removed assertions that expected workflow overrides or poisoned-recovery annotations, replaced with assertions that no query occurs and disk projection is authoritative.

decisions.what: Render Epic projection facts before advisory convergence in adv_epic_show
decisions.why: AC4 requires base read to succeed without a live workflow. Retired snapshots skip convergence; active Epics attempt convergence only after the base render is available, so convergence failure cannot block the projection read.

decisions.what: Wrap convergeEpicOnShow in try/catch and emit _unavailable marker on global unreachability
decisions.why: Convergence is advisory. If the live change workflow is globally unreachable (no poller, deadline, etc.), the handler returns the base Epic with a typed _unavailable scope/reason instead of failing or silently omitting facts.

decisions.what: Rethrow global workflow unreachability from convergeEpicOnShow instead of masking as per-entry target_unreachable
decisions.why: Per-entry unreachability is a normal degraded state; global unavailability (service down, no poller, deadline) must surface explicitly so adv_epic_show can report it without blocking the base read.

decisions.what: Return success:false with code epic_retirement_unavailable for status=completed when live evaluation is unreachable
decisions.why: AC4 requires completed-candidate dry-run evaluation to return explicit non-success when its live Epic workflow is unreachable, never an empty-success report.

decisions.what: Preserve existing dry-run retire semantics for reachable workflows
decisions.why: The completed-candidate report remains a non-mutating evaluation; only global unavailability changes the response shape.

decisions.what: Extend worker-free-read-guard.test.ts with adv_epic_list/adv_epic_show boundaries
decisions.why: AC5 requires a single shared structural guard for routine host-tool read paths; Epic handlers are now projection-first and contain no workflow-query constructs in their handler blocks.

decisions.what: Create dedicated epic.worker-free.test.ts instead of appending to epic.test.ts
decisions.why: Keeps AC4/AC5 evidence focused and readable; avoids mixing with signal-driven Epic mutation tests.

subagent_reports.architecture_assessment: CAUTION. Projection-first adv_gate_status is the correct boring design: it can return the durable change projection already loaded at plugin/src/tools/gate.ts:1298-1310 and avoid worker-routed queries. Current code then issues getGateStatus, getGateCriteria, and getAcceptanceCriteriaProjection queries at lines 1328-1352, so no-worker reads still fail outside the narrow poison/completed fallback at lines 1353-1372. Preserve change list/show behavior: list uses listSummary/list at plugin/src/tools/change.ts:1087-1104 and show uses changes.get at lines 1402-1417; neither should be re-routed through new query helpers. Keep Epic list completed as the existing dry-run retirement-candidate report, not a terminal-history list: plugin/src/tools/epic.ts:1320-1391 calls retire({dryRun:true}) and tests pin candidates plus blocked entries at plugin/src/tools/epic.test.ts:2640-2748. Keep Epic-show convergence bounded to same-project active Epics; cross-project entries are skipped and retired projections are read-only at plugin/src/tools/epic.ts:977-987 and 1222-1227. CLI status primary-read failure is already fail-closed at bin/adv:139-203; optional resume enrichment is bounded and rendered with explicit completeness at bin/lib/optional-enrichment.ts:1-67 and bin/lib/resume-projection-state.ts:21-94. Sources: https://github.com/temporalio/sdk-typescript/blob/main/packages/client/src/workflow-client.ts ; file:///home/jon/dev/advance/plugin/src/tools/gate.ts#L1294-L1458 ; file:///home/jon/dev/advance/plugin/src/tools/change.ts#L1087-L1104 ; file:///home/jon/dev/advance/plugin/src/tools/epic.ts#L1222-L1391 ; file:///home/jon/dev/advance/bin/adv#L139-L203.

validation.notes: Necessary corrections: (1) gate status must make the already-loaded projection authoritative and make criterion/acceptance enrichment optional, typed, and non-authorizing; it must not let a query failure discard gates/nextGate/canArchive. (2) A shared structural guard must cover every designated worker-free read module, not only bin/lib/live-status.ts; current guard checks only that file and only textual getHandle/query tokens (bin/lib/dead-worker-query-paths.test.ts:27-56). (3) Preserve Epic completed-mode dry-run semantics and show convergence boundaries. (4) Preserve CLI status primary failure behavior: Temporal/Visibility failure yields live:false, zero active rows, remediation, and exit 2 (bin/adv:195-203; bin/lib/live-status.ts:105-122). Sources: file:///home/jon/dev/advance/bin/lib/dead-worker-query-paths.test.ts#L27-L56 ; file:///home/jon/dev/advance/bin/adv#L195-L203 ; file:///home/jon/dev/advance/bin/lib/live-status.ts#L105-L122.

tradeoffs: Projection-first reads remain available without a worker but cannot expose freshness-only criterion/acceptance details unless those details are durably projected. Source: https://github.com/temporalio/sdk-typescript/blob/main/packages/client/src/tools/gate.ts#L1328-L1352 ; https://github.com/temporalio/sdk-typescript/blob/main/packages/client/src/workflow-client.ts.
A broader static guard prevents regressions but requires a maintained explicit allow/deny module list. Source: file:///home/jon/dev/advance/bin/lib/dead-worker-query-paths.test.ts#L27-L56.

alternatives_considered.option: Keep gate-status workflow queries with a catch-and-disk fallback
alternatives_considered.rationale: A normal no-worker path still errors because only poisoned/completed query errors fall back; ordinary unavailable workers rethrow. Source: file:///home/jon/dev/advance/plugin/src/tools/gate.ts#L1353-L1372 ; https://github.com/temporalio/sdk-typescript/blob/main/packages/client/src/workflow-client.ts.

alternatives_considered.option: Move all change list/show reads to Visibility
alternatives_considered.rationale: This expands scope and would discard established summary/full projection behavior without evidence it is needed. Current list/show use their own store read paths. Source: file:///home/jon/dev/advance/plugin/src/tools/change.ts#L1087-L1104 ; file:///home/jon/dev/advance/plugin/src/tools/change.ts#L1402-L1417.

alternatives_considered.option: Expand Epic show convergence across projects or retired Epics
alternatives_considered.rationale: Current boundaries intentionally defer cross-project work and keep retired projections read-only. Source: file:///home/jon/dev/advance/plugin/src/tools/epic.ts#L977-L987 ; file:///home/jon/dev/advance/plugin/src/tools/epic.ts#L1222-L1227.

architecture_judgement.recommendation: Proceed after encoding gate status as projection-first with typed optional-enrichment degradation, retaining the stated list/show and Epic boundaries, and adding a shared deterministic worker-query-path guard plus targeted regressions.

subagent_reports.recommendation: CAUTION: implement projection-first adv_gate_status; preserve adv_change_list/show paths; retain completed Epic list as non-mutating candidate analysis and Epic show same-project/non-retired convergence; use a shared structural query guard; preserve CLI primary fail-closed output. Test obligations: no-worker gate-status returns projected gates plus typed omitted/degraded enrichment; no query invocation; change list/show call paths unchanged; completed Epic report remains dry-run and captures blocked rows; show skips cross-project/retired convergence; guard fails a forbidden query in every protected module and permits explicit boundary modules; CLI Temporal/Visibility failure returns zero active rows, live:false, remediation, non-zero exit; resume timeout/rejection publishes non-complete state. Sources: file:///home/jon/dev/advance/plugin/src/tools/gate.ts#L1294-L1458 ; file:///home/jon/dev/advance/plugin/src/tools/epic.ts#L1255-L1395 ; file:///home/jon/dev/advance/bin/adv#L139-L203 ; file:///home/jon/dev/advance/bin/lib/resume-projection-state.ts#L49-L95.
follow_ups: Packet omitted TASK_SCOPE, IN_SCOPE, OUT_OF_SCOPE, DONE_WHEN, STOP_WHEN, and VERIFICATION anchors; scope was taken from TASK only, per packet-defect protocol.

I do not know whether the planned typed gate-status degradation schema already has a contract in the change design because that artifact was not supplied in the packet; define and test it before implementation.

# Extend the worker-free read principle from the CLI to the `adv_*` tool surface

## Problem

ADV has established three times that **read paths must not require a live per-project worker** — `rq-statusCliWorkerFree01` (status table), `rq-dashboardWorkerFree01` (dashboard), `rq-launcherProjectionTruth01.2` (Temporal-independent read). `fixWorkerDependentResume` is currently closing the last CLI holdout.

Every one of those applies to `bin/adv`. **None applies to the `adv_*` plugin tool surface**, which is what agents and MCP consumers actually read through. Those tools still resolve state by querying the change workflow, so when a workflow's session queue is orphaned they fail — and the agent loses the ability to see its own project.

## Root Cause Analysis

**Same mechanism, different surface.** Task queues are named `advance-<projectId>-sess_<sessionId>`. A worker polls only queues it knows about; workflows from ended sessions have no poller. Per Temporal: *"A Worker must be online to process the query."*

`fixWorkerDependentResume` diagnosed this precisely and fixed it for `bin/`. Its scope declaration is explicit — `bin/lib/resume-projection-live.ts`, `bin/adv`, `bin/lib/dashboard/adv.ts`. The plugin tool surface is not mentioned, so the identical defect survives there untouched.

**Observed 2026-07-28.** Worker booted 03:26 (a `deploy-local.sh` bounce); session started 10:20. Against a workflow orphaned before that bounce:

| Read | Result |
| --- | --- |
| `adv_change_show`, `adv_gate_status` | `not_found` |
| `adv_change_list includeArchived: true` | `0` archived, against 390+ bundles on disk |
| `adv_epic_list` | `[]` |
| `adv_epic_show optimizeAdvToolSurface` | `EPIC_NOT_FOUND`, while a live change carried `epic_membership` naming that exact `epic_id` |

The data existed on disk throughout. Only the read path was broken.

**The aggravating factor is the error shape.** These return `not_found` / `[]` — indistinguishable from genuine absence. An agent cannot tell "this does not exist" from "I cannot reach this", so it reasons confidently from false absence. This also defeats recovery tooling: `adv_change_workflow_terminate` refused to act on a change whose archive bundle was verifiably merged to trunk, because its precheck `describe` returned `not_found`.

## Why this is now cheap

`fixWorkerDependentResume`'s design (KD2) established, against the source, that **no producer-side work is required**. `writeChangeProjection` (`plugin/src/temporal/activities.ts:457`) already persists `state: input.state` — the *full* workflow state including `lifecycleState`, `tasks[]`, `same_project_dependencies[]`, `epic_membership`. Active epic projections are likewise already written by `saveActiveEpicProjection` (`plugin/src/storage/epic-projection.ts:104`) and readable under the full `EpicSchema`.

Their design also records the trap to avoid: the *aggregate* (`LauncherChangeSummarySchema`) and *summary shard* (`ChangeSummaryShardSchema`) are thin downstream caches and were initially mistaken for the per-change projection. The per-change projection is the authoritative, complete one.

Consequence: this is a **consumer-side change** — no schema migration, no `wf.patch`, no replay risk.

## Scope

- `adv_change_show`, `adv_gate_status` — resolve from the durable per-change projection.
- `adv_epic_list`, `adv_epic_show` — resolve from the active epic projection.
- `adv_change_list includeArchived: true` — stop returning empty when archive bundles exist on disk.
- Typed completeness markers on these reads, following `fixWorkerDependentResume`'s KD4 (`completeness: complete|partial|unavailable`, `omitted_reason`) so degraded is never silently rendered as absent.
- A structural guard that fails on workflow-query constructs in tool read paths, generalizing the existing `plugin/src/cli-bridge-contract.test.ts` assertion (their KD9) rather than adding a second bespoke policy.

## Out of scope

- Signals and mutations — a signal must reach a live workflow and cannot be served from disk. Owned by `fixStalledOrphanQueueAdoption` (#327).
- `bin/adv` CLI and dashboard — owned by `fixWorkerDependentResume`.
- Producer/projection-writing changes — established as unnecessary by their KD2.

## Constraints

- **Preserve the fail-closed split (their KD5).** `rq-statusCliWorkerFree01.2` requires the status table to fail closed on Visibility failure with zero active rows and no disk substitute. Disk data must not leak into surfaces that are required to fail closed. This change must assert that boundary, not erode it.
- Reads become worker-free; they must not become *stale-silent*. Freshness and completeness must be visible to the caller.
- No relaxation of the CLI import boundary beyond what their KD7 sanctions.

## Sequencing

Follows `fixWorkerDependentResume` rather than racing it — that change establishes the pattern, the reader helpers, and the structural guard this one generalizes. Complementary to `#327`: that change restores signal reachability, this one removes the read dependency entirely. Together they cover the full surface; neither alone does.

## Evidence

Backlog `bl-workerQueueReadBlackout` (repro, timing, degraded-read table). Change `fixWorkerDependentResume` proposal + design (KD1, KD2, KD4, KD5, KD7, KD9), PRs #335, #336. Issues #327, #303, #302. Wisdom `pw-sPe4vZA3` (disk projection is sole truth once a workflow orphans), `pw-Dofp-UCz`. Spec-law: `rq-statusCliWorkerFree01`, `rq-dashboardWorkerFree01`, `rq-launcherProjectionTruth01.2`.

# Agreement: worker-free host-tool reads

## Objective

Make routine host-tool reads truthful when an individual change or Epic workflow has no live task-queue poller, without changing the CLI status table’s Visibility fail-closed contract.

## In scope

1. Convert `adv_gate_status` from live workflow query dependence to durable per-change projection reads.
2. Preserve and test the existing projection-backed behavior of `adv_change_show` and ordinary `adv_change_list`, including archived results.
3. Make Epic read behavior explicit: routine active/retired projection rendering must not depend on a worker; `status:"completed"` evaluation and membership-convergence writes must be typed as unavailable/advisory when a workflow cannot be reached.
4. Add one shared structural guard covering host-tool routine read paths, rather than a separate bespoke policy.

## Acceptance criteria

- **AC1 — worker-free gate status:** Given a valid durable change projection and an unreachable change workflow, `adv_gate_status` returns the persisted gate map and next gate without issuing a workflow query; a targeted test proves this path.
- **AC2 — truthful incompleteness:** When projection data cannot authoritatively provide gate criteria or acceptance projection, `adv_gate_status` returns an explicit typed unavailable/degraded marker and reason; it never derives those fields from absence or returns a false pass.
- **AC3 — archive read continuity:** With archived projection/bundle data available and no live workflow, `adv_change_list({ includeArchived: true })` returns the archived row(s), while corrupt/unavailable summaries produce explicit completeness/warning metadata rather than an empty-success result.
- **AC4 — Epic boundary:** With an unreachable Epic workflow, ordinary `adv_epic_list`/`adv_epic_show` still render active or retired projection facts; completed-candidate evaluation and convergence cannot silently report success when their live operation is unavailable.
- **AC5 — structural and regression protection:** A shared automated guard rejects workflow-query constructs in designated routine host-tool read paths. Handler tests cover one unreachable-worker case for gate status and one for each affected Epic boundary.
- **AC6 — preserved fail-closed split:** The CLI status table still returns zero active rows on Visibility failure and does not use disk/projection data as an active-row substitute; its existing contract test remains green.

## Constraints

- No producer/projection-writing changes, workflow patches, or replay-semantic changes.
- No mutation is reclassified as worker-free.
- Preserve `rq-statusCliWorkerFree01` and avoid expanding the CLI import boundary.
- Projection freshness/completeness must be visible; stale or unavailable data is never rendered as genuine absence.

## Evidence basis

Discovery traced `adv_gate_status` live queries, projection-backed change reads, Epic convergence/completed-mode live boundaries, the `ReadSnapshot` typed model, the existing CLI worker-free guard, and status-table fail-closed law.

# Design: worker-free host-tool reads

## Decision

Routine read handlers consume only durable typed projections. A handler may expose workflow-derived enrichment only as explicitly unavailable/degraded; it may not query a live workflow as a prerequisite to render base read facts.

## Read authority map

| Surface | Base authority | Live operation boundary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `adv_change_show` | `readChangeSnapshot` / full change projection | Optional include enrichments must be audited separately; base change facts remain projection-only. |
| `adv_change_list` | summary projections and archive bundle/projection facts | No workflow query for normal or `includeArchived` listing. Summary corruption/unavailability is reported as completeness metadata. |
| `adv_gate_status` | full change projection: persisted gates, task state, contract and other durable fields | Workflow-only criteria/acceptance details are omitted with typed `unavailable`/reason when not durably provable. |
| `adv_epic_list` | active/retired Epic projections | The existing `status:"completed"` non-mutating retirement-candidate dry run remains distinct from base listing and returns typed unavailable/degraded rather than empty success when its live evaluation is unreachable. |
| `adv_epic_show` | active/retired Epic projection | Render base projection before advisory convergence. Preserve existing skips for cross-project members and retired snapshots; convergence signals/writes do not control read success. |

## Gate-status response

1. Load the full `ReadSnapshot<Change>` once.
2. For `found`, render the persisted gate map, `nextGate`, archive eligibility, and contract-derived facts directly from that projection.
3. For any requested field not durably represented, add a typed completeness entry with `status: unavailable` and a specific reason. Do not infer pass/fail from absent data.
4. For `not_found` or corrupt/degraded snapshots, return the existing typed not-found/repair shape; never convert it to a successful empty gate map.
5. Remove workflow handle/query construction from the routine handler path.

## Epic response boundaries

- Projection rendering is primary and has no live handle.
- Completed-status classification preserves its non-mutating candidate-evaluation semantics. Its unavailable result carries reason/provenance and cannot be rendered as `[]` or successful completion assessment.
- Membership convergence runs after base read construction, is best-effort only where existing law permits, skips cross-project members and retired snapshots, and reports its outcome separately. No convergence signal is attempted merely to serve a routine projection read.

## Completeness model

Reuse the existing typed read-model/degradation vocabulary rather than inventing untyped warning strings. Every degraded result identifies scope, omitted field/evaluation, reason, and projection provenance/revision when available. This makes stale or unavailable distinguishable from genuine absence.

## Structural guard

Generalize the worker-free guard into a single test-owned allow/deny map for routine host-tool read modules. The guard fails if a designated routine path imports or invokes workflow handle/query constructs. It explicitly excludes mutation handlers and the CLI status table, which retains its separate Visibility-only fail-closed test.

## Tests

- Gate handler: unreachable workflow fixture still returns persisted gates/next gate; query spy proves zero calls.
- Gate handler: unavailable non-projected criteria are typed unavailable, not passed or absent-success.
- Change list: archived projection/bundle still appears without a workflow; degraded summary records completeness metadata.
- Epic list/show: projection rendering succeeds with an unreachable workflow; completed evaluation/convergence report typed non-success while preserving dry-run, cross-project, and retired-snapshot boundaries.
- Structural guard: designated host-tool readers contain no workflow-query path.
- Regression: existing CLI status Visibility-failure test remains unchanged and green.

## Non-goals

No task-queue adoption, workflow migration, producer write change, workflow patch, replay behavior change, or disk fallback for the CLI status active table.

# Outcome

Routine ADV host-tool reads no longer require a live change or Epic workflow worker to report durable facts. Agents can see persisted gates, archived change summaries, and Epic projection state instead of receiving false empty/not-found results after session queue loss.

## Delivered value

- `adv_gate_status` reads persisted gate state and reports unavailable workflow-only details explicitly.
- Change show/list behavior is regression-protected for projection and archived reads.
- Epic show renders durable projection facts before advisory convergence; completed-candidate evaluation reports a typed unavailable result when live evaluation cannot run.
- A shared structural guard prevents workflow-query calls from returning to designated routine host readers.
- CLI status retains its Visibility-only fail-closed behavior.

## Verification

- Independent acceptance review: READY; 139 focused tests passed.
- Task-level verification passed: 68 gate tests, 24 change/guard/CLI tests, and 13 Epic/guard tests.
- Post-rebase release hardening: READY; 86/86 focused regressions across six files passed; worktree clean, diff check passed, and branch is current with trunk.
